title: Presence Operations
description: A readable operations review: scalable health, fixed/scalable comparisons, workload, JVM generations, collection and buffers.

options.content:
## Presence Operations
Fixed and scalable membership, under the same workload.

**N = 1,000** initial capacity · **1%** sizing target · **1-second** telemetry

panels.title: Distinct Input IDs
panels.description: Exact generator count, including seeds and excluding repeated puts. Both filters receive the same inputs.

panels.title: Reachable Heap
panels.description: Scalable core object graph, measured with JOL. Includes headers and shared reachable objects; excludes the SDK. Not exclusive retained heap.

panels.title: Allocated Layers
panels.description: Scalable storage layers, including the initial layer.

panels.title: False-Positive Rate
panels.description: Measured cumulative false positives / known-absent probes for scalable. A possible match alone cannot establish a false positive.

panels.title: Active Layer Fill
panels.description: Fullest slice in the scalable active layer. Growth occurs before it exceeds 50%.

panels.title: Memory Footprint
panels.description: Core reachable heap (solid) and bit-array payload (dashed). Shared objects mean reachable sizes are not additive as exclusive retained memory.

panels.title: Distinct IDs and Estimates
panels.description: Known distinct input IDs versus occupancy estimates. Fixed estimates become unreliable near saturation and may be infinite; scalable skips already-possible matches.

panels.title: Layer Growth
panels.description: Scalable retains older layers when it allocates a new one. Fixed remains at one.

panels.title: Scalable Fill
panels.description: The active layer's fullest slice. Allocation resets the active fill; old membership remains.

panels.title: Fixed Fill
panels.description: Fraction of logical bits set. At full saturation every query is a possible match.

panels.title: Absent Probes per Filter
panels.description: Exact count of never-inserted queries, identical for both filters.

panels.title: Scalable False Positives
panels.description: Cumulative positive answers for never-inserted IDs; initialized to zero.

panels.title: Fixed False Positives
panels.description: Cumulative positive answers for never-inserted IDs; initialized to zero.

panels.title: Scalable Accuracy
panels.description: Measured: cumulative observed false positives. Estimated: uniform-hashing occupancy model. The 1% line is the sizing target. Each chart has its own vertical scale.

panels.title: Fixed Accuracy
panels.description: Measured: cumulative observed false positives. Estimated: uniform-hashing occupancy model. The 1% line is the sizing target. Each chart has its own vertical scale.

panels.title: Insert Calls
panels.description: Calls per second, including repeated puts. This is paced smoke traffic, not a throughput benchmark.

panels.title: Lookup Outcomes
panels.description: Lookup calls per second. Possibly present is not proof of duplication; definitely absent rules out membership.

options.content: Memory below belongs to the **whole Java process**: both filters, telemetry, and tooling. Pool names come from the active collector; undefined maxima stay absent.

panels.title: Heap Usage
panels.description: Whole-process heap from MemoryMXBean, not container RSS or filter-only memory.

panels.title: Heap After Collection
panels.description: Last collection snapshot where supported. It is not current occupancy. No forced GC is requested.

panels.title: $heap_pool
panels.description: Used, committed, reported maximum and peak usage. Pools appear automatically. Their maxima must not be added as reserved shares of -Xmx.

options.content: Collection counts and approximate elapsed time, by collector. GC elapsed time is **not a stop-the-world pause histogram**; quiet runs may show zero.

panels.title: Collection Rate
panels.description: Collections per second. Undefined counters remain absent.

panels.title: Collection Time Rate
panels.description: Approximate collector elapsed seconds per second, not application pause fraction or CPU usage.

panels.title: Total Collections
panels.description: Cumulative counts since this smoke JVM started.

panels.title: Total Collection Time
panels.description: Cumulative collector elapsed seconds. Concurrent phases can overlap; do not sum as exclusive pause time.

panels.title: Metaspace and Code Heaps
panels.description: Used memory by actual non-heap pool. Metaspace, class space and code heaps are separate from direct buffers and total native memory.

panels.title: Direct and Mapped Memory
panels.description: Buffer memory used and logical capacity. Mapped size is not resident physical memory.

panels.title: Buffer Counts
panels.description: Estimated process-wide buffer count by JVM-reported pool.

options.content:
### Reading This Run
**Zero** means a measurement was observed. **No data** means samples are missing for the selected run or time range.

Rates need multiple samples. After a smoke ends, use its printed **completed-run link** to keep the full interval in view.

Filter heap is a reachable object graph, not exclusive retained memory. JVM memory includes the whole process.
